question: How many ATP and NADPH does this cycle use to fix 3 CO₂, and what happens to the 6 GAP?
reference_answer: 3 CO₂ + 3 ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate (C5, by RuBisCO) give 6 3-phosphoglycerate (C3). 6 ATP make 6 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate, 6 NADPH reduce them to 6 GAP (releasing 6 Pi). One GAP leaves the cycle as the net product (sugar); the other 5 GAP (15 C) are rebuilt into 3 ribulose-5-phosphate, which 3 ATP turn back into 3 RuBP. Total per 3 CO₂: 9 ATP and 6 NADPH.

checks.description: Of the 6 GAP, 5 are recycled (into 3 ribulose-5-phosphate / RuBP) and 1 leaves as the net product.
